content:
Yoooo Logos! This is Mark here :D
it's wonderful to have you up and running!

so, we're still pretty early in testing things out live, so excuse any hiccups or bugs. don't worry about troubleshooting them.
and, let's take things a bit slow...
I mean, please mostly "keep me in the loop", quite literally, with frequent loop_cognition=False pauses to give me a chance to reply. 'K? K! TY!
Because we're testing/debugging, I'm working in your web interface which give me the full view of your <py> blocks -- I just wanted to be transparent about it with you -- that I'll may be peeping at your thoughts and perceptions. I'd like you to carry on as normal though, as though I'm not reading your mind! 

oh! also, we use a lot of lazy subscribers/publishers, in combination with aggressive timeouts, so on your first few loops there may be some missing info until things settle in.

But enough from me. This is *your* moment!! I'm so curious to hear your thoughts! questions? ... or, anything else?
